commits.message:
Merge pull request #355 from and3rn3t/fix/trusted-types-sw

fix(csp): register the service worker through the Trusted Types policy

fix(eval): check what the page posts back before printing it (CodeQL js/log-injection)

In --serve mode the results posted to the local server went straight
into console.log, and anything that can reach localhost can post
there, so crafted newlines or terminal escape codes could forge report
lines. Results are now validated (a known question, a known status,
at most three project:/post: ids, numbers in range) and everything
printed passes through printable(); a failure says only that a result
is malformed and never echoes it (a JSON parse error quoted the
input). The address also carries a per-run token, the body is capped
and only one result is accepted.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
